title: FacetQueryState
description: Formal schema for faceted search filter state, URL parameter bindings, and zero-PII situational context.

query.description: Free text search string. Bound to URL parameter 'q'.

types.description: Filter by entity classification. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'type'.

pillars.description: Filter by security pillar. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'pillar'.

categories.description: Filter by taxonomy category slug. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'category'.

archetypes.description: Filter by traveler archetype. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'archetype'.

lifecyclePhases.description: Filter by travel lifecycle phase. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'phase'.

riskTiers.description: Filter by risk tier. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'risk'.

formats.description: Filter by medium format. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'format'.

priceTiers.description: Filter by price bracket. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'price'.

destinations.description: Filter by destination city slug. Bound to repeated URL parameter 'dest'.

countryCode.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter. Bound to URL parameter 'country'.

spofOnly.description: When true, filters exclusively for items resolving single points of failure. Bound to 'spof=1'.

sortBy.description: Sorting rule. Bound to URL parameter 'sort'.

personalizedOnly.description: When true, activates local-first zero-PII personal trip filter. Bound to 'personalized=1'.
